meta.description: Is it over? No, this is only the start of something new.

units.displayText: Yeah, we did.

units.rawText: Professor?! What are you doing here?!
units.displayText: Professor?! What are you doing here?!

spans.text: Professor?! What are you doing here?!

units.rawText: Well, it was your comeback concert, after all. As your producer, how could I ever be absent?
units.displayText: Well, it was your comeback concert, after all. As your producer, how could I ever be absent?

units.displayText: Did you see that, Professor? We did it! The agents of Cyclopes Sector were cheering for us.

spans.text: Did you see that, Professor? We did it! The agents of Cyclopes Sector were cheering for us.

units.displayText: They used to be so aloof, but just now, their eyes were shining as they watched us.

units.displayText: How were we on stage today, Professor?

units.displayText: Er...

spans.text: Er...

spans.text: So you don't know, huh... Oh right, could you help us find out who sent it?

units.rawText: And to think she nearly put a hole in us two weeks ago... Still, who sent that invitation, anyway? Was it really just a prank?

spans.text: No, I'm fine... Thank you for telling me. I'll make sure I "notify" the Professor.

units.rawText: I have no idea what happened, but if you need to "teach them a lesson", I'm more than willing to provide any technical assistance needed.

units.displayText: You set us up, Professor!

spans.text: You set us up, Professor!

spans.text: Ehhhh??

units.rawText: You sent the invitation, didn't you?
units.displayText: You sent the invitation, didn't you?

spans.text: You sent the invitation, didn't you?

units.rawText: You had us come to Cyclopes on a concert tour but didn't tell us anything beforehand. Thanks to you, we almost got arrested.
units.displayText: You had us come to Cyclopes on a concert tour but didn't tell us anything beforehand. Thanks to you, we almost got arrested.

spans.text: You had us come to Cyclopes on a concert tour but didn't tell us anything beforehand. Thanks to you, we almost got arrested.

units.rawText: If this was just to prank us, then I have to say that my image of you as a mature individual has taken a severe beating.
units.displayText: If this was just to prank us, then I have to say that my image of you as a mature individual has taken a severe beating.

spans.text: If this was just to prank us, then I have to say that my image of you as a mature individual has taken a severe beating.

units.displayText: Er...

units.displayText: Olivia's voice chimes in at just the right moment to rescue me from my predicament.

spans.text: Olivia's voice chimes in at just the right moment to rescue me from my predicament.

units.rawText: The Professor wanted to create an opportunity for me.

spans.text: The Professor wanted to create an opportunity for me.

units.rawText: I've spent the past two months discussing the changes in the Cyclopes agents with the Professor. I think you may have sensed that they're different from how they usually are.

units.displayText: Some of them responded to our show.

spans.text: Some of them responded to our show.

units.rawText: Yes, they're slowly developing a sense of camaraderie and emotions.
units.displayText: Yes, they're slowly developing a sense of camaraderie and emotions.

spans.text: Yes, they're slowly developing a sense of camaraderie and emotions.

units.rawText: Perhaps this path is one we must all walk down, just like how we changed when Simo came.
units.displayText: Perhaps this path is one we must all walk down, just like how we changed when Simo came.

spans.text: Perhaps this path is one we must all walk down, just like how we changed when Simo came.

units.rawText: But where will they go once they're free of the bindings of their commands? I know I shouldn't nip their developing feelings in the bud like before, but is it really alright to let these feelings go rampant?
units.displayText: But where will they go once they're free of the bindings of their commands? I know I shouldn't nip their developing feelings in the bud like before, but is it really alright to let these feelings go rampant?

spans.text: But where will they go once they're free of the bindings of their commands? I know I shouldn't nip their developing feelings in the bud like before, but is it really alright to let these feelings go rampant?

units.rawText: Having richer emotions may very well influence one's battlefield judgment. This is not a trivial decision for the Cyclopes Sector.
units.displayText: Having richer emotions may very well influence one's battlefield judgment. This is not a trivial decision for the Cyclopes Sector.

spans.text: Having richer emotions may very well influence one's battlefield judgment. This is not a trivial decision for the Cyclopes Sector.

units.rawText: Indeed. Therefore, I've been hesitating over what to do about it. However, 4You and the Professor have helped me come to a conclusion.
units.displayText: Indeed. Therefore, I've been hesitating over what to do about it. However, 4You and the Professor have helped me come to a conclusion.

spans.text: Indeed. Therefore, I've been hesitating over what to do about it. However, 4You and the Professor have helped me come to a conclusion.

units.rawText: This concert has shown me new possibilities for them beyond their current duties. It reminds me of how she struggled in the past to break the shackles on her.
units.displayText: This concert has shown me new possibilities for them beyond their current duties. It reminds me of how she struggled in the past to break the shackles on her.

spans.text: This concert has shown me new possibilities for them beyond their current duties. It reminds me of how she struggled in the past to break the shackles on her.

units.rawText: Perhaps it's time I installed new modules into them and allowed them to find new meaning in their lives.
units.displayText: Perhaps it's time I installed new modules into them and allowed them to find new meaning in their lives.

spans.text: Perhaps it's time I installed new modules into them and allowed them to find new meaning in their lives.

units.rawText: Whew... Looks like that invitation had the desired effect. Those three days of vacation I paid off Antonina with were worthwhile...

spans.text: Whew... Looks like that invitation had the desired effect. Those three days of vacation I paid off Antonina with were worthwhile...

units.rawText: Hehe, I suppose the Professor didn't directly instruct you to come here to give you some confidence and so you'd pay more attention to Cyclopes' agents.

spans.text: Hehe, I suppose the Professor didn't directly instruct you to come here to give you some confidence and so you'd pay more attention to Cyclopes' agents.

units.rawText: However, after seeing today's enthusiastic response, I don't think you'll need to hack our systems anymore, Professor. We can have Cyclopes Sector directly invite 4You over next time.

spans.text: Perhaps we should be the ones thanking you.
